model.group_rule: hidden_dim / 8 in the 17 central spatial convolutions
model.activation_policy: upstream ReLU at A32, clamp[0,1]+uniform quantization at lower modes; stem ReLU and linear bottleneck/residual paths are FP exceptions
model.batchnorm: five independent banks at every BatchNorm location

protocol.training_loss: hard CE at 32; detached recursive soft CE at 8/4/2/1; gradients summed; one Adam step per global batch
protocol.checkpoint_policy: diagnostic partial-epoch checkpoint only; any later full training starts from zero

timing_scope: Each step contains all five precision forwards; training also contains five backwards and one Adam update. No extra factor five.
memory_scope: PyTorch caching-allocator allocated/reserved/peak counters and CUDA device-free bytes; not physical residency or Windows shared GPU memory.

last_progress.message: Tijdmeting evaluatie: 1.000 beelden, alle vijf precisies, geen updates.

dataset.integrity: official torchvision CIFAR10 MD5, including metadata
dataset.train_order: prefix of seeded permutation of all 50,000 official training examples; no replacement
dataset.validation_selection: 100 per class by default; seeded without replacement from official test split
dataset.augmentation_rng: worker torch seed; dedicated DataLoader generators, no bit-exact resume claim
dataset.scope: timing probe only, not a validation score for model selection

model_summary.name: MobileNetV2-CIFAR10-K3-reconstruction
model_summary.optimizer_memory_estimate_excludes: activations, workspaces, caches, step tensors and buffers
model_summary.first_and_last_weight_layers: FP32 stem Conv2d and FP32 final Linear
model_summary.weight_quantization: Unchanged released Any-Precision tanh/E quantizer, including its non-identity 32-bit path
model_summary.activation_quantization: At placed nonlinear internal activations: ReLU for 32, clamp[0,1] and round for 1/2/4/8
activation_fp32_exceptions: Raw normalized input, stem convolution and stem ReLU are not activation-quantized.
Linear projection BN outputs and residual additions have no extra activation or quantizer.
Consequently the next expansion convolution can consume a floating-point linear/residual output.
Pooling, dropout, classifier and softmax/loss remain floating-point.
model_summary.precision_label_scope: A bits describe placed quantizers, not every intermediate tensor or every convolution input
model_summary.bn_policy: Independent bank for each of 1/2/4/8/32 at every BN site, including stem; each selected once per full update

accuracy_interpretation: Diagnostic partial-epoch training; 1,000-example evaluation only. Not a trained-model or paper accuracy comparison.

timing_summary.tail_batch_policy: conservative: last partial batch counted as a full 128-image batch
timing_summary.scenario_definition: p10/p90 of observed steady full-batch times, extrapolated; not a confidence interval
notes: One row already covers all five precisions. No extra factor of five is applied.
One complete training epoch means all 50,000 train images; validation means all 10,000 official test images.
Initial imports, dataset checksum/loading, worker startup, first CUDA warmup and notebook time are excluded from the extrapolation.
Report/JSON output outside the supplied wall_s intervals is not included; the caller reports total loop wall time separately.
Checkpoint estimate assumes one measured write per epoch; changed checkpoint policy changes the total.
A short run cannot establish sustained thermal performance or final accuracy.
Real-data estimate uses measured end-to-end minibatch wall time, including data wait and transfers.
